name: Clean
long_description:
Agents can run outreach on their own now.

In manufacturing, insurance, defense and banking, buying runs on a clock. Every deal has a transaction window almost nobody can see. Reach out before it opens and nobody answers. After it closes, the deal's gone.

Clean finds that window and gives agents and sales teams the strategy to win the deal.

We're building the revenue intelligence every sales agent will run on.
one_liner: Revenue intelligence for agents and sales teams.

launches.title: Clean: Real-time company data for sales teams and their agents
launches.tagline: Know what just changed at every account you sell to, and what to do about it.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Clean watches 1,000+ live sources and keeps a running picture of every company you sell to: what changed, when, why it matters and who to talk to. Our customers have made over $1M in revenue with it. Try it at \[[tryclean.ai](http://tryclean.ai)\](<https://tryclean.ai>).

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qZO3QrW57os>

**Sales data is old the day you pull it**

Every sales team works off a snapshot. An Apollo export, a ZoomInfo list, a Clay table, all frozen at one moment. Meanwhile the companies on that list change every week. They open a plant, switch a supplier, hire a new VP. And now everyone's building sales agents that read the same databases and send the same emails, so the gap only gets bigger.

The teams that win will be the ones who know what just changed at an account, and what it means for them. That's what Clean does.

**A real example**

One of our customers makes custom battery packs. A company they wanted to sell to was a hybrid-electric aircraft maker. Over two months, Clean picked up:

\- **Week 0:** they announce a new plant

\- **Week 1:** they sign their engine supplier

\- **Week 8:** they fly their first demo flight

Alone, none of that means much. Together, it means the plane is real, the engine is decided and the battery is the next thing they buy. Clean flagged the account and the person who picks suppliers. He replied to our customer in 15 minutes. They'd signed a battery supplier that same week, and he still wanted to hear more.

That's how small the window is.

**How it works**

1\. **Learns your business** from your docs and website.

2\. **Watches 1,000+ sources:** filings, press releases, spec sheets, hiring posts and more, lined up per company as events happen.

3\. **Tells you what matters:** which accounts are in market, what changed, who decides and how to open. Every signal is sourced.

4\. **Lives where you work:**

   - Your own agents

   - Claude, Codex and your other AI tools

   - Your CRM and sequences

   - Our app

   - Our API and MCP

**More than leads**

Timing is one signal. The same live picture tells you which prospects to prioritize, which customers are ready to expand and which accounts are showing risk. We're building Clean to be the company data layer behind every step of the customer relationship, for humans and agents alike.

**Results**

\- One customer closed **$60K in their first week**

\- Reply rates went from **4% to 19%**

\- Weekly booked meetings are **up 32%**

**Team**

We're four technical, sales-heavy founders. Pavan is a 2x founder who was closing enterprise deals at Cisco straight out of high school, then led growth at a seed-stage startup to $300K+ in revenue and 28M views in six months. Clarissa won the International Physics Olympiad, then turned down a quant offer from Citadel to build Clean. Pratham is a top open-source builder whose app has 10K+ users, and did AI research backed by India's richest person, alongside IIT researchers. Tejas is an operator who previously scaled a startup to $40M, and 2x time as well.

**Our ask**

If you sell B2B, especially into manufacturing, insurance, fintech, legal or infrastructure, book a demo at [tryclean.ai](http://tryclean.ai) or email [yc@tryclean.ai](mailto:yc@tryclean.ai). If you're building sales agents and want live company data behind them, we'd love to talk.
